description: Create a new Search Engine Service cluster on 3rd-generation KVM servers (G3). Use dryRun=true to preview.

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, '-'; starts with a letter, ends with a letter or number)

dataNodeStorageInfraResourceDetailTypeCo.description: Data node storage type code. Documented valid value: CB1

dataNodeStorageSize.description: Data node storage in GB (100-16000, 10GB increments)

dryRun.description: If true, preview only without creating

generationCode.description: Server generation code. G3 for 3rd generation

isMasterOnlyNodeActivated.description: Enable dedicated master nodes. If true, the three masterNode* parameters below are required

managerNodeProductCode.description: Manager node server type code (from ncloud_ses_get_server_specs)

masterNodeCount.description: Number of master nodes (3 or 5, default: 3). Required when isMasterOnlyNodeActivated=true

masterNodeProductCode.description: Master node server type code. Required when isMasterOnlyNodeActivated=true

masterNodeSubnetNo.description: Master node subnet number. Required when isMasterOnlyNodeActivated=true

searchEngineUserName.description: Admin account ID (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, '-')

searchEngineUserPassword.description: Admin password (8-20 chars, letters+numbers+special; excludes ' " ` ₩ / & and spaces)

serverSpecCode.description: Server spec code. Optional here, unlike the CDSS G3 create where it is required

softwareProductCode.description: G3 OS image code (see ncloud_ses_get_cluster_server_images; e.g. SW.VELST.OS.LNX64.ROCKY.08.G003)

name: ncloud_ses_create_cluster_g3
